comments.author: Twisell
comments.story_title: Ask HN: How comfortable do you feel using cloud-based password managers?
comments.why_zh: 让评论者从 1Password 转向了 iCloud 钥匙串。
comments.quote_zh: 我试过 1Password，但看完这个 BlackHat 2016 视频后最终还是决定用 iCloud 钥匙串
comments.text_zh: 我试过 1Password，但看完这个 BlackHat 2016 视频后最终还是决定用 iCloud 钥匙串 [VIDEO]。我的意思是，既然我已经信任他们的操作系统，那如果他们心怀不轨，其实没有什么能真正阻止我被他们窥探，所以只要他们是认真的、能及时修补安全漏洞，我就能接受。另外，如果你不需要超过 5GB 的 iCloud 存储空间，它还是免费的。我觉得用外部密码管理器只会多出一个需要我信任的第三方，而 1Password 提供浏览器应用界面（在原生应用之外）这一点也完全不能让我更放心。当然，如果有一天我因为不能再信任 Apple 而需要重新评估我的威胁模型，我会在弃用他们操作系统的同时退出 iCloud 服务，全面转向 FOSS。
comments.text: I tried 1Password but finally resolved to use iCloud keychain after watching this BlackHat 2016 video [VIDEO] . I mean as far as I already trust their OS nothing can really protect me from being spied by them if they are ill intentioned, so as long as they are serious and patch their security flaw on a timely manner I can live with that. Beside it come as a free plan if you don't need more than 5GB of iCloud storage. I'd figure using an external password manager just add another third party I need to trust and the fact that 1Password offer browser app interface (on top of native) don't reassure me in any way. Of course if I'd ever need to reassess my threat model because I can't trust Apple anymore, I will quit iCloud service at the same time as their OS and go full FOSS.

comments.text_zh: 这不只是传输中加密或简单的客户端加密。这是端到端加密，其中每台设备的密钥生成都由你手机的 Secure Enclave 处理。这篇文章对于 Advanced Data Protection 是什么是个不错的起点：[LINK]。如果你想深入了解 iCloud Keychain 的安全工程，苹果安全工程与架构（SEAR）负责人这场 Blackhat 演讲的后半部分非常精彩：Synchronizing secrets：[VIDEO]
comments.text: This is not just encryption in transit or simplistic client-side encryption. It is end-to-end encryption, where each device's key generation is handled by your phone's Secure Enclave. This article is a decent starting point in terms of what Advanced Data Protection is: [LINK] If you want a deeper dive into the security engineering of iCloud Keychain, the second half of this Blackhat talk by Apple's head of Security Engineering & Architecture (SEAR) is really great: Synchronizing secrets: [VIDEO]

comments.author: Shank
comments.story_title: Our Approach to Privacy
comments.why_zh: Apple 关于 iOS 安全架构的公开演讲。
comments.quote_zh: Black Hat 上关于 iOS 安全的演讲
comments.text_zh: 归根结底，一切都要看公开可见的东西。FBI 曾试图让 Apple 创建一个 iOS 变体，以便从设备中提取数据，以至于 Tim Cook 写了一封信拒绝这样做，并愿意在法庭上抗争到底。类似地，Apple 也做过关于 iOS 安全性的演讲并发布过白皮书。与这些详尽记录的白皮书和讨论 iOS 内部机制的演讲相呼应的是，我们并没有看到任何知名或简单的漏洞利用浮出水面，能证明这些机制存在缺陷。以 FBI 那场风波为例，我们知道 FBI 后来付钱给 Cellebrite 购买了一个漏洞利用，使他们能够解锁那台设备。我们不知道具体是怎么做到的，但 FBI 不得不求助于一家独立公司，并利用一个较老设备上的漏洞才做到。说清楚一点：如果他们在加密、设备安全和用户信任方面所做的大量努力上撒了谎，事情就会是另一个样子。FBI 早就已经有后门，或者能轻而易举地破解设备，或者他们早就配合了，创建一个 iOS 变体来入侵。我们所知道的只是他们坚守的立场，以及 FBI 为了进入设备所付出的努力。iOS 10 安全白皮书：[LINK] Black Hat 上关于 iOS 安全的演讲：[VIDEO]
comments.text: It all boils down to what you see in the public. The FBI was trying to get Apple to create an iOS variant to extract data from a device, to the point where Tim Cook wrote a letter refusing to do so and was willing to fight it in court. In a similar fashion, Apple has given talks and white papers on iOS security. In tandem with these well documented white papers and talks discussing the internal functions of iOS, we haven't seen any well known or trivial exploits appear to surface that demonstrate flaws in them. In the case of the FBI fiasco, for example, we know that the FBI later paid Cellebrite for an exploit that allowed them to unlock the device. We don't know the details of how that happened, but the FBI had to reach out to an independent company and exploit an older device to do it. To be clear: if they were lying about the lengths they go to with encryption, on device security, and user trust, this story would have been different. The FBI would have already had a backdoor or been able to trivially break the device, or they would have complied and created an iOS variant to break in. All we know is what they stood their ground on, and the effort that was required for the FBI to get in. iOS 10 security white paper: [LINK] Talk about iOS security at Black Hat: [VIDEO]
